edges.description: JAK2-SH2B3-axis lesions converge on JAK2 signaling and downstream proliferative, NF-kappaB, and inflammatory transcriptional programs.
Proliferative cytotoxic CD8+ T cells home to and damage the epidermis, causing extensive keratinocyte necrosis and ulcerating cutaneous lesions.
Rapidly proliferating malignant CD8-positive cytotoxic T cells can disseminate systemically to visceral organs and the central nervous system.
Epidermotropic infiltration of cytotoxic CD8-positive T cells causes extensive keratinocyte necrosis and clinical ulceration of papules, plaques, and tumors.
Epidermotropic and dermal accumulation of malignant cytotoxic CD8+ T cells produces erythematous plaques and skin nodules.
